scenarios.why: Screen (455,116) = window (455,108) (WinMax without border: win_top row 1). PsmGetPickToolBox: 450<=455<477, 104<=108<119, 455<463 -> psm.tool=PSMTT_BOX_TOOL=1 (PsalmodyDraw.HC:320-331).

scenarios.name: record two notes, rewind, play
scenarios.why: Tempo 4.4*36/80+0.5=2.48 beats/s; each 0.5 s note = 1.24 beats; PsmCvtDuration returns the first j with d < d_j*d_(j+1)/(d_j+d_(j+1)) -> j=9 (threshold 1.714) = 'h.' 3 beats (PsalmodyMain.HC:252-263,755-763). Notes are appended before psm.head, so the current note stays at the end and 'x' alone would play nothing; GoBegin (CTRL-Left) moves to the first note. Playback: Snd(ona-8) for 1000*3.0/2.48*0.901 = ~1090 ms, ~120 ms silence, then the base note likewise (665-681).

scenarios.why: car 7 starts 1/8 track (~25.7k units) behind at 25 units/pass (618-622, 517-518) and hits the stationary player on the road (541-548) after ~1030 passes (~10-11 s on TempleOS; later on mobile if passes are starved)

scenarios.name: restart resets and the race still runs (P1 check)
scenarios.why: Init sets distance=0 and speed 0 (615, 624); new UP presses make AnimateTask add distance again (550): distance > 0 and the program has not ended; additionally Fs->draw_it of the main task must still be DrawIt (TempleOS never clears it)

scenarios.name: ESC exits
scenarios.why: CH_ESC -> vr_done (690-692), cleanup, program ends

scenarios.name: right arrow moves the king one step
scenarios.why: king starts at w/2=320 (297) and moves +KING_STEP=6 (555-556)

scenarios.name: menu Play/Left moves one step left
scenarios.why: menu sends SC_CURSOR_LEFT (464); king_x=320-6 (560-561)

scenarios.name: held key without typematic is one step
scenarios.why: movement is per KEY_DOWN (GetKey 540); a single key-down (no repeat generator in the kernel) gives exactly one step

scenarios.name: ENTER restarts
scenarios.why: Init puts the king back at w/2 (297, 541-544)

scenarios.name: king y with TempleOS window geometry
scenarios.why: king_y = h/2-6 = 230 with the 472-px client of WinBorder+WinMax (298,570-571); 234 with a 480-px window

scenarios.name: all peasants walking at start
scenarios.why: game not finished after 1 s: tf==0 unless all 10 random peasants started within 20 px of the house (396)

scenarios.name: SPACE ends the program
scenarios.why: GetChar returns on a non-zero ASCII key (Whap.HC:166; Message.HC:182-190) and Whap returns

scenarios.name: arrow key is ignored
scenarios.why: GetChar skips keys with ch==0 (Message.HC:186-187); program keeps running

scenarios.name: mouse drag does not end it
scenarios.why: mouse messages are discarded by GetChar/ScanKey (Message.HC:123-140)

scenarios.name: File/Abort ends it
scenarios.why: menu sends CH_SHIFT_ESC (Whap.HC:119), GetChar returns

scenarios.name: purple balls converge and collide
scenarios.why: six purple balls drift toward the centre at ~50 px/s from at most ~700 px (67-75,129-131), overlap and set collision_t=t (81-84)

scenarios.name: box y range with TempleOS window geometry
scenarios.why: box_y_min = 6*pix_height/8 = 354 with WinBorder+WinMax's 472-px client (Zing.HC:124; Adam/Win.HC:503-515); a 480-px window gives 360

scenarios.name: drag inside the box shoots and ends drawing
scenarios.why: L_UP clears bow_drawn (Zing.HC:193) after spawning an arrow (185-191)

scenarios.name: idle bow is clamped to the box after releasing outside it
scenarios.why: DrawIt clamps the pointer x to box_x_max=360 and, not drawing, sets bow_x to it (Zing.HC:23,31); same value whether or not MsSet warps the pointer

scenarios.name: ESC exits after key-up
scenarios.why: ESC leaves the loop (173-175), the key-up satisfies GetMsg (197)

scenarios.name: ESC without key-up keeps waiting
scenarios.why: GetMsg(,,1<<MSG_KEY_UP) (197) blocks until a key-up

scenarios.name: ENTER restarts and keeps running
scenarios.why: '\n' runs CleanUp+Init (169-172); program continues

scenarios.name: ten enemies at start
scenarios.why: Init sets num_them=THEM_NUM=10 (213)

scenarios.name: forward moves 51 units along x
scenarios.why: us zeroed (211), MoveUs(0) adds 0.1*512*Cos(0)=51.2 to an I64 (175)

scenarios.name: menu Play/Fwd equals the key
scenarios.why: menu sends SC_CURSOR_UP (259) -> 298-299

scenarios.name: ENTER resets the player
scenarios.why: Init MemSets us (211)

scenarios.name: not completed at start
scenarios.why: tf=0 until all ten are hit (220,123-124)
